articles.headline: AI Revolution Looms Large with AGI Arrival Predicted by 2030
articles.summary: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis predicts that artificial general intelligence (AGI) could arrive around the year 2030, marking a significant shift in human history. He believes this transformative technology will initiate a new era for humanity, surpassing current capabilities across various tasks. Hassabis sees society at the brink of a technological singularity where AI is reshaping how we live and work. While acknowledging public concerns about AI's impact, he advocates for collaboration among diverse fields to navigate these changes effectively
